thread:
emma: quick idea  tiny inline inspector in the route list that shows: model, deployed version, 1m avg latency, token burn/min, and sampling %. hover to reveal, click to pin. useful for on-call triage.

diego: +1. How do we avoid 200 API hits when someone scrolls?

emma: batch endpoint and rate-limit the hover to 1/10s per client. also cache per org for 5s.

ruoxi: API proposal: GET /console/route_inspectors?route_ids=1,2,3&fields=model,version,latency,tokens,sample_rate,last_eval. returns compact CSV-like rows or small JSON array. payload per route < 1kb.

diego: prefer JSON array, easier to extend. but compact field names: m,v,l,t,s,e.

infra-bot: note: we already have a /routes/:id/health endpoint. duplication risk. keep inspector read-only and cacheable; mark as low-cost meter in billing to avoid unexpected bill spikes.

emma: agree. meter separately and tag inspector_batch_fetch in telemetry for cost tracking.

diego: UX: hover on desktop, keyboard focus opens same inspector, pin icon to persist. if pinned, it subscribes to websocket updates for the pinned route.

ruoxi: websocket for pins sounds heavy; make subscribe optional behind feature flag console.inspector_realtime. default off.

design-bot: design note: when fallback differs from primary, show a subtle "fallback" indicator + small orange dot. also, show "sampled 12%" with a tooltip linking to telemetry settings. add aria-labels.

emma: accessibility: hover-only is not okay. must open on focus and expose keyboard shortcut (i).

diego: rollout plan: behind org feature flag, internal orgs first, then staged. infra-bot: created flag inspector_list_beta_2026_03.

infra-bot: feature flag created: inspector_list_beta_2026_03, default: off, rollout: internal-only.

ruoxi: API contract notes: response fields are optional when unknown. e.g. last_eval may be null. don't include large nested objects. TTL and cache-control header required. allow batch size up to 50 route_ids. return 202 if batch exceeds limit with retry-after.

emma: add telemetry events: inspector_batch_request (count), inspector_hover_open, inspector_pin_toggle. include org_id, user_id (hashed), and batch_size.

diego: tests: unit for compact serializer, integration test for cache header, e2e for keyboard focus.

emma: perf target: list view load with inspector disabled should be no slower. when enabled, batch call should be <150ms p50 for 20 routes.

ruoxi: security: only return data for routes the user can read. also redact eval scores if evals are private.

emma: good catch. add server-side permission check and empty fields if unauthorized.

design-bot: I'll schedule a quick design review. drop mocks in PR.

diego: I'll draft the API PR with compact fields and batch support. tagging ruoxi for server-side.

emma: thanks team. follow-ups: 1) include tiny "last deploy" timestamp? 2) show whether route uses dedicated capacity or hosted fallback.

diego: add deploy_ts small field 'd_ts' and a mode field 'mode' with values dedicated/hosted. keep names short.

emma: perfect. will create the feature ticket and link the PR. :thumbsup:
